item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Agathlaos #7824 the Twice-Bor
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Agathlaos #7824 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: Kledotos #4787 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scatter
item.description: Kledotos #4787 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
